lesson.design_your_spaceship.title: Design Your Spaceship
lesson.design_your_spaceship.summary: Learn a sturdy spaceship foundation, then choose, combine or invent details that make the final design unmistakably yours.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.step.hull: Start with a strong main hull. Think about the silhouette first: tall, compact, sleek or chunky can all work.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.help.hull: Keep the main hull large enough to leave room for windows, engines and your own design ideas.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.step.cockpi: Place a cockpit or main window where it supports the shape of your hull.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.help.cockpi: Try moving the cockpit higher or lower in your own drawing if that makes your ship feel more interesting.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.step.wings: Add wings and engines to give the ship direction and balance. They do not have to mirror each other perfectly.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.help.wings: Compare the outer silhouette on both sides. Change the angles if you want a faster, heavier or stranger-looking ship.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.step.ideas: Here are a few ideas—an antenna, an emblem and another window shape. Choose one, combine them, change them, or invent something completely different.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.help.ideas: Ask what your spaceship needs: a sensor, cargo door, shield mark, extra engine, unusual window or something nobody has seen before.
lesson.design_your_spaceship.complete.dr: This spaceship is your design. The choices you added are part of what makes it yours.
